info.comment: Read the lowercase info header and judge its keyword boundary through subsequent directives. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and info.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows info.md#hidden-yaml.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows info.md#hidden-directive-and-line-endings.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows info.md#comments-and-common-trivia.
Read the bounded showInfo flag through following directives. Follows info.md#keyword-boundaries and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows info.md#composite-common-forms.

info-line-final-keywords.comment: Read the reserved accessibility description keyword when only padding and directives remain on its physical line, including after another complete unit. A later-line value receives its surrounding context's scopes. Follows info.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
